name: One Strange Night
source:
You, an intrepid college student, went to a Halloween party, saw friends, had some drinks, and discussed very important questions about life and monsters and movies. Then, on your way home, there was a misty fog and you somehow lost your way. You got lost. Very, very lost...

[From [url=https://avarisharkay.itch.io/one-strange-night]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你，一个勇敢的大学生，去参加万圣节派对，见朋友，喝点饮料，讨论关于生活、怪物和电影的非常重要的问题。然后，在回家的路上，雾气弥漫，你不知怎么迷了路。你迷路了。非常非常失落…

[来自[url=https://avarisharkay.itch.io/one-strange-night]Itch.io[/url]]
